column1: # Fake-names build (build.py --fake-names): the game's own stand-in names for the
# roster, in place of the real names in text/wrestlers.tsv. Same rules as that file:
# short is shown alone in the select list (max ~56 px, about 6 letters); full is the
# whole name (max 18 bytes when it doesn't start or end with short); nick (max ~140 px)
# replaces the nickname where the English one names something real, else it is empty.
